uxObservations.userGoal: Understand what the website does upon arrival
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: A pre-filled A4 CV template in two columns with professional formatting.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Looked around the screen to identify clickable zones.
uxObservations.recommendation: Visual presentation of the document is immediately recognizable as a CV.

uxObservations.userGoal: Read onboarding advice explaining Human vs ATS formats
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Interactive guided tour spotlighting layout and tools with a dark backdrop over the CV.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Observed tour tip and clicked dismiss / advance to enter editor.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: The dark backdrop blocks canvas editing until dismissed, but text provides valuable context on ATS vs Human layout.
uxObservations.recommendation: Keep tour concise or allow clicking directly on canvas to dismiss.

uxObservations.userGoal: Replace the sample candidate name with my own name
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Text cursor appeared directly inside the heading text.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked the name and typed new text in-place.
uxObservations.recommendation: In-place WYSIWYG text editing feels completely intuitive.

uxObservations.userGoal: Set job title
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Subtitle field highlighted.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Modified subtitle text directly.

uxObservations.userGoal: Find export, print, and design tools
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Narrow 16px vertical handle on the left edge with chevron icons.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Searched edges of the screen, noticed the subtle chevron handle on the left, and clicked it.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: First-time users might not notice a 16px collapsed strip with no text label. They expect toolbar controls at the top or a persistent sidebar.
uxObservations.recommendation: Show an animated subtle tooltip on the peek handle during the first 10 seconds of a new session: "Haz clic aquí para abrir herramientas".

uxObservations.userGoal: Change the font family to Inter and inspect scale slider
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Typography settings modal with font family dropdown and scale slider labeled in multiplier format (1.00x).
uxObservations.actionTaken: Selected Inter font family.
uxObservations.recommendation: Multiplier format (1.00x) is much clearer to users than raw px values.

uxObservations.userGoal: Adjust margins and gaps
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Sliders for Page Margin (24px), Section Gap (12px), Item Gap (6px).
uxObservations.actionTaken: Viewed spacing settings.

uxObservations.userGoal: Save a named version before making extensive changes
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Input field with auto-suggested name and "Guardar" button.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Entered "Borrador Inicial" and clicked Guardar.
uxObservations.recommendation: Saving snapshots with human-readable names gives great peace of mind.

uxObservations.userGoal: Audit my CV with an LLM for ATS compatibility
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Pre-filled prompt containing my actual CV data and target role.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Viewed prompt and close button.

uxObservations.userGoal: Export finished CV as a clean PDF
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Immediate toast notification "Generando PDF optimizado y preparando impresión..." followed by native print output.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked red PDF export icon.
uxObservations.recommendation: Fast feedback with zero lag.

uxObservations.userGoal: Find the button to add a new section to the resume
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Dashed line or button at the bottom of the column.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Hovered over the bottom of the right column to reveal "+ Agregar Sección".
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: The button to add a section is opacity-muted or only revealed when hovering over the column container. Naive users looking for "+ Sección" might not realize they have to mouse over the empty area below existing content.
uxObservations.recommendation: Provide a persistently visible "+ Agregar Sección" button or pill at the end of each column with subtle styling rather than relying on hover.

uxObservations.userGoal: Browse available resume sections
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Floating panel docked next to the CV canvas with categorized section cards (Languages, Awards, Projects, Certificates, etc.).
uxObservations.actionTaken: Inspected the section options.
uxObservations.recommendation: Floating panel to the right of #area-cv avoids obscuring the document and lets the user see what is already on the page.

uxObservations.userGoal: Add a Languages section to the CV
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: New section appeared instantly at the end of the column with default language items.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked Languages card in the modal.
uxObservations.recommendation: Smooth insertion of sections with pre-populated defaults gives immediate guidance.

uxObservations.userGoal: Add a new social link (e.g., GitHub or LinkedIn) to the CV header
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: A dashed pill button "+ Contacto" inline with existing contact pills.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Located and clicked the "+ Contacto" button.
uxObservations.recommendation: The dashed pill button integrates seamlessly into the pill list and makes adding new channels obvious.

uxObservations.userGoal: Search and select a specialized contact type (e.g., GitHub or Telegram)
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Floating popover menu with search bar, category chips (All, Dev, Redes), and standardized icons.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Typed "git" into the search bar to filter dev options.
uxObservations.recommendation: Search filter with category tabs makes locating specific networks quick and effortless.

uxObservations.userGoal: Delete an unnecessary contact item
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Minus icon button next to contact pill text.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked minus button to delete pill.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: The minus icon is quite small (11px) and sits very close to the text, making it slightly tricky on high-DPI screens or mobile touch devices.
uxObservations.recommendation: Ensure minimum 24x24px hit area for the contact deletion button to avoid misclicking the text.

uxObservations.userGoal: Add a profile photo to resume
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Resume template without photo by default (ATS optimized).
uxObservations.actionTaken: Checked document layout.
uxObservations.recommendation: Hiding photo by default prevents recruiter bias and preserves ATS compatibility.

uxObservations.userGoal: Customize the visual style of section bullets and title dots
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Three horizontal dots icon (MoreHorizontal) in the section header action buttons on hover.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Hovered over the section and clicked the three dots button.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: The three dots icon is ambiguous: users might expect it to be a general menu (Copy, Move, Settings) rather than specifically a bullet/circle style configurator.
uxObservations.recommendation: Change the icon to a bullet-list or palette icon, or provide a tooltip: "Personalizar viñetas".

uxObservations.userGoal: Add another bullet accomplishment to my current job
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Inline button "+ Agregar nueva viñeta" below current job bullets.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked the add bullet button.
uxObservations.recommendation: The explicit text "+ Agregar nueva viñeta" is immediately clear to naive users.

uxObservations.userGoal: Delete an accidental or obsolete bullet point
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Minus circle button on the right edge of the bullet row.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked minus button to delete bullet.
uxObservations.recommendation: Direct row deletion is snappy and responsive.

uxObservations.userGoal: Open version history and backup hub
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Fullscreen modal showing version management cards, save bar, and JSON controls.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked versions icon in the left toolbar.
uxObservations.recommendation: Full modal presentation with cards and timestamps is very confidence-inspiring.

uxObservations.userGoal: Create a named backup of the CV
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: New card appeared in version list with timestamp and name.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Typed version name and clicked "Guardar Versión".
uxObservations.recommendation: Instant visual card feedback confirms the backup succeeded.

uxObservations.userGoal: Prevent accidental erasure of the resume
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Confirmation modal warning that current changes will be replaced with a blank template.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Observed warning modal and clicked Cancel.
uxObservations.recommendation: Strong safety barrier protects user from catastrophic accidental deletion.

uxObservations.userGoal: Understand how many physical pages my resume currently spans
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: 1 physical paper-like sheet(s) with clear drop shadows and margins.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Observed editor document canvas.
uxObservations.recommendation: Physical discrete sheets (Invariant 15) eliminate the guesswork of where page breaks fall.

uxObservations.feature: Page Separation Margin in Editor View
uxObservations.userGoal: Clearly differentiate page 1 from page 2 while editing
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Inter-page spacing with visible margin (32px) separating sheets.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Scrolled down to view boundary between pages.
uxObservations.recommendation: Visual separation between discrete A4 sheets gives instant WYSIWYG feedback.
